title: Meetnetten.be chorus counts of three priority anurans at 121 ponds, Flanders, Belgium, 2016-2025
creator: Piesschaert, Frederik; Speybroeck, Jeroen; Brosens, Dimitri; Westra, Toon; Desmet, Peter; Ledegen, Hannes; Van de Poel, Sander; Pollet, Marc (Research Institute for Nature and Forest, INBO)
citation: Piesschaert F, Speybroeck J, Brosens D, Westra T, Desmet P, Ledegen H, Van de Poel S, Pollet M (2026). Meetnetten.be - Chorus counts for Amphibia in Flanders, Belgium. Version 1.27. Research Institute for Nature and Forest (INBO). Samplingevent dataset. https://doi.org/10.15468/d4bu8j
abstract: Repeated counts of calling males of three priority anurans at fixed ponds in Flanders, from the Meetnetten.be monitoring networks run by INBO and Natuurpunt Studie with specialised volunteers: European tree frog (Hyla arborea), common spadefoot (Pelobates fuscus) and natterjack toad (Epidalea calamita). Each pond belongs to the network of one species (__survey_taxa) and is visited at least twice in the breeding season; one row per visit with the number of calling males of that species.
samplingProtocol: Chorus count: the number of calling males of the target species is counted at the breeding pond, at least twice a year (Meetnetten.be protocols for tree frog, common spadefoot and natterjack toad; obs_protocol gives the source's protocol label).
closureNote: occasion = visit within a breeding season; period = calendar year; the protocol repeats counts within a season for N-mixture estimation
geographicCoverage: Flanders, Belgium (INBO 1, 5 and 10 km UTM centroids, coarsened to 0.1-degree cell centres)

coordinatesCoarsened.method: coarsen_coords(): the UTM-square centroids INBO publishes (1, 5 or 10 km; uncertainty 707, 3536 or 7071 m) snapped to their 0.1-degree cell centre, because the source flags the species as sensitive and generalises their locations (E7); uncertainty = the source's plus the cell half-diagonal.

notes: Each pond is in one species' network (__survey_taxa). obs_protocol is the source's protocol label per visit (spadefoot visits move from the generic 'amphibia choir count' to the network's own 'Knoflookpad - Roepkoren' protocol between 2018 and 2022). Tree frog 2016-2025, spadefoot 2017-2025, natterjack 2018 only. 62 visits hold several rows of the target species, absent and present rows mixed, with no field telling them apart; they are summed into y and obs_n_records gives the number of rows. The source's occurrenceRemarks 'casual observation' is on every row, absences included, and is not a record type.

notShipped.Poelkikker project: 157 visits at 49 ponds 2021-2024 for the pool frog: the Pelophylax records mix a lessonae/esculentus aggregate with species-level classes and name the synklepton twice, and 44 visits have no row for P. lessonae, so the taxa surveyed for at a visit cannot be recovered
notShipped.incidental records: non-target amphibians recorded as present (no survey for them)
